# package index

```go
import "github.com/otfabric/go-iec61850/scl/index"
```

Package index provides a shared, indexed view of a parsed SCL model.

An [Index](#type-index) is built once from a normalized [scl.SCL](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/otfabric/go-iec61850/scl#SCL) document and gives O(1) lookup for IEDs, access points, logical devices, logical nodes, data type templates, datasets, report controls, and connected access points. Duplicate or ambiguous entries are reported as diagnostics rather than silently overwritten.

## Types

### type AccessPointKey

```go
type AccessPointKey struct {
	IED string
	AP  string
}
```

AccessPointKey uniquely identifies an access point within an IED.

ControlKey uniquely identifies a control block by its owning LN and name.

### type Index

```go
type Index struct {
	IEDs         map[string]*scl.IED
	AccessPoints map[AccessPointKey]*scl.AccessPoint
	LDevices     map[LDeviceKey]*scl.LDevice
	LNs          map[LNKey]*scl.LN
	LNodeTypes   map[string]*scl.LNodeType
	DOTypes      map[string]*scl.DOType
	DATypes      map[string]*scl.DAType
	EnumTypes    map[string]*scl.EnumType
	DataSets     map[DataSetKey]*scl.DataSet
	Reports      map[ControlKey]*scl.ReportControl
	GSEControls  map[ControlKey]*scl.GSEControl
	SMVControls  map[ControlKey]*scl.SMVControl
	ConnectedAPs map[AccessPointKey]*scl.ConnectedAP
}
```

Index provides O(1) lookup into a normalized SCL model. Build one with [Build](#func-build).

#### func Build

```go
func Build(s *scl.SCL) (*Index, []scl.Diagnostic)
```

Build constructs an Index from a parsed SCL model. Duplicates and ambiguous entries are reported as diagnostics. A diagnostic quotes each name of the document cut to [scl.DefaultMaxDiagnosticName](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/otfabric/go-iec61850/scl#DefaultMaxDiagnosticName) bytes.

#### func (Index) ResolveLNType

```go
func (idx *Index) ResolveLNType(ln *scl.LN) *scl.LNodeType
```
